title: Mountain Blue Orchards wins historic lawsuit in China over illegal propagation of blueberries
summary: Report that the Kunming Intermediate People's Court upheld Mountain Blue's plant breeders' right over 'Ridley 1602' (Eureka Sunrise) against an unlicensed Chinese nursery.
why_it_matters: Successful plant variety rights enforcement in China is unusual and materially changes the risk-reward of licensing genetics into that market. It also confirms that Mountain Blue enforces internationally, not only in Australia.

reading.rationale: A precedent-setting outcome in the fastest-growing market.

commercial_position.rationale: Enforceability in China is a gating factor for premium genetics strategy there.

monitoring.rationale: Follow subsequent Chinese plant variety rights cases closely.
